Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff. @0s  Fix: Split this sub-composition further into smaller .html files, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 22 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Source: Internal analytics" at 13 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md. @9.25s
The film has no sound: no clip in it plays audio. @0s

host id "nyt-chart-comp", composition id "nyt-chart" and file "nyt-chart" differ. The hyperframes skill says this makes each render wait ~45s per scene; HyperFrames own shipped examples do it and hyperframes check does not flag it, so the render cost is unverified here. Matching them is safest
font-size 16px < minimum 28px for this format (ignore only for decorative micro-labels)
no hero object found (needs data-mh-hero, an MH.world instrument/3D/path/callout, media, or a diagram with >= 6 shapes): a scene of only text and flat blocks reads as sparse
